Neither screenshot shows the components, so item 3 and the badge part of item 4 can't be confirmed for either answer. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots show only the top of the page, so the components can't be compared. Both cut 22 colors to 12, show the kept values with swatches and list what each token replaces. A states the reduced counts for every scale up front and uses somewhat more role-based token names. B is easier to navigate thanks to its jump links, but its brand colors are named by hue (Navy, Blue, Sky), so overall the two come out about even.
